reading: A notable absence marked a recent ayatollah's funeral in Iran, as the country's Supreme Leader did not attend, sparking considerable speculation.
Senior Iranian officials were present, underscoring the gravity of the spiritual leader's passing, yet the supreme authority's non-attendance remained conspicuously significant.
This unusual omission from a high-profile religious observance has led analysts to scrutinize the underlying dynamics within the Iranian political establishment.
Concurrently, Mojtaba Khamenei, a prominent figure and son of a high-ranking cleric, has maintained a low public profile, fueling further conjecture.
His disappearance from public view reportedly follows an attack which tragically claimed the life of his father, an event shrouded in official silence.
The timing of these developments is particularly salient, unfolding at the outset of heightened tensions related to the US-Israel conflict with Iran.
Such an unprecedented convergence of events inevitably generates an environment of uncertainty and prompts questions regarding leadership stability.
The absence of the Supreme Leader, coupled with Mojtaba Khamenei's reclusion, suggests potential internal shifts or security concerns that warrant close observation.
Observers are keenly watching for any discernible indications of a power vacuum or a subtle recalibration of influence within the Islamic Republic.
The lack of transparent communication from Tehran regarding these high-stakes occurrences only exacerbates the ambient air of mystery surrounding the nation's leadership.

vocabulary.definition: Clearly noticeable and important, drawing particular attention due to its prominence or unusual nature.
To examine or inspect something very carefully and thoroughly, often with a critical eye, to understand its details or implications.
Causing or contributing to the growth of further speculation, guesses, or hypotheses based on incomplete information.
hidden or kept from being clearly understood
To make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse or more severe.
the people and institutions that hold established political influence
a situation in which no clear authority is exercising control
not known to have happened before
an adjustment to the balance or direction of something
at the same time as another development or activity

entries.ja: 際立って目立ち、その重要性や異例な性質のために特に注目を集める様子。
entries.ko: 명확하게 눈에 띄고 중요하며, 그 두드러짐이나 특이한 성격 때문에 특별한 주목을 끄는.
entries.zh-Hans: 清晰可见且重要的，因其突出或不同寻常的性质而特别引人注意的。
entries.es: Claramente perceptible e importante, que atrae una atención particular debido a su prominencia o naturaleza inusual.
entries.pt-BR: Claramente perceptível e importante, que chama atenção especial devido à sua proeminência ou natureza incomum.

entries.ja: 何かの詳細や意味合いを理解するために、批判的な視点を持って、非常に注意深く徹底的に調べたり検査したりすること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것의 세부 사항이나 의미를 이해하기 위해 비판적인 시각으로 매우 조심스럽고 철저하게 검토하거나 조사하다.
entries.zh-Hans: 仔细而彻底地检查或审视某事物，常带批判眼光，以理解其细节或含义。
entries.es: Examinar o inspeccionar algo con mucho cuidado y a fondo, a menudo con una mirada crítica, para comprender sus detalles o implicaciones.
entries.pt-BR: Examinar ou inspecionar algo com muito cuidado e minuciosidade, muitas vezes com um olhar crítico, para compreender seus detalhes ou implicações.

entries.ja: 不完全な情報に基づいて、さらなる憶測、推測、または仮説が増大する原因となったり、それに貢献したりすること。
entries.ko: 불완전한 정보에 기반하여 추가적인 추측, 짐작 또는 가설의 증가를 유발하거나 기여하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 基于不完整信息，引起或助长进一步的推测、猜测或假设的产生和发展。
entries.es: Causar o contribuir al aumento de más especulaciones, conjeturas o hipótesis basadas en información incompleta.
entries.pt-BR: Causar ou contribuir para o aumento de mais especulaciones, suposiciones o hipótesis basadas en información incompleta.

entries.ja: 隠されていて、明確に理解されないようにされていること。
entries.ko: 숨겨져 있거나 명확하게 이해되지 않도록 감춰진.
entries.zh-Hans: 隐藏或不让人清楚理解的。
entries.es: Oculto o impedido de ser entendido claramente.
entries.pt-BR: Escondido ou impedido de ser claramente compreendido.

entries.ja: 問題、悪い状況、またはネガティブな感情を、より悪い、またはより深刻なものにすること。
entries.ko: 문제, 나쁜 상황 또는 부정적인 감정을 더 나쁘거나 더 심각하게 만들다.
entries.zh-Hans: 使问题、不良情况或负面情绪变得更糟或更严重。
entries.es: Empeorar o hacer más grave un problema, una mala situación o un sentimiento negativo.
entries.pt-BR: Tornar um problema, uma situação ruim ou um sentimento negativo pior ou mais grave.

entries.ja: 確立された政治的影響力を持つ人々や組織。
entries.ko: 확립된 정치적 영향력을 가진 사람들과 기관들.
entries.zh-Hans: 拥有既定政治影响力的人员和机构。
entries.es: Las personas e instituciones que poseen influencia política establecida.
entries.pt-BR: As pessoas e instituições que detêm influência política estabelecida.

entries.ja: 明確な権威が統制を行使していない状況。
entries.ko: 명확한 권위가 통제를 행사하지 않는 상황.
entries.zh-Hans: 没有明确权威行使控制权的情况。
entries.es: Una situación en la que ninguna autoridad clara está ejerciendo control.
entries.pt-BR: Uma situação em que nenhuma autoridade clara está exercendo controle.

entries.ja: 以前に起こったことが知られていない。
entries.ko: 이전에 일어난 적이 없는 것으로 알려진.
entries.zh-Hans: 以前未曾发生过的事情。
entries.es: Que no se sabe que haya ocurrido antes.
entries.pt-BR: Que não se sabe ter acontecido antes.

entries.ja: 何かのバランスや方向性を調整すること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것의 균형이나 방향에 대한 조정.
entries.zh-Hans: 对某事物的平衡或方向进行的调整。
entries.es: Un ajuste al equilibrio o la dirección de algo.
entries.pt-BR: Um ajuste no equilíbrio ou na direção de algo.

entries.ja: 別の進展や活動と同時に。
entries.zh-Hans: 与另一进展或活动同时发生。
entries.es: Al mismo tiempo que otro desarrollo o actividad.
entries.pt-BR: Ao mesmo tempo que outro desenvolvimento ou atividade.
